name: Secret Organizations
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid secretive and deceptive practices that oppose the openness and truth found in Christ. Jesus declared that He taught openly and never spoke in secret, emphasizing transparency in His ministry. Believers are cautioned against hypocrisy and the subtle corruptions of worldly philosophies that lead away from Christ. Upholding the holiness of God's name and guarding against deceitful traditions are vital in resisting the influence of hidden organizations that operate contrary to biblical truth.
